```{r data loading}

MER61E_regions <- import("data/Bed_exports/repeatmasker_sets/ERV1/MER61E_ERV1_LTR.bed")

LTR10E_regions <- import("data/Bed_exports/repeatmasker_sets/ERV1/LTR10E_ERV1_LTR.bed")

sampleinfo <- read_delim("data/sample_info.tsv", delim = "\t")

H3K27ac_ext200_anno <- readRDS("data/TE_annotation/annotated_H3K27ac_ext200_TE_overlaps.RDS")

# KZFP_motif_info <- readRDS("data/RDS_files/KZFP_motif_info.RDS")

H3K27ac_summit_gr <- readRDS("data/RDS_files/H3K27ac_complete_summit_gr.RDS")

H3K27ac_summit_gr_ext <- resize(H3K27ac_summit_gr, width(H3K27ac_summit_gr)+400, fix = "center")

human_protein_coding_KZFPs <- read_excel("data/Other_paper_data/human_protein_coding_KZFPs_Davis_natgen_2026.xlsx")


MER61E_set_3 <- H3K27ac_ext200_anno %>% 
  separate_longer_delim(., cols=c(repClass:repID),delim=";") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(repName=="MER61E",
                cluster=="Set_3") %>% 
  pull(repID)
KZFP_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = human_protein_coding_KZFPs$chrom,
                   ranges= IRanges(start=human_protein_coding_KZFPs$start+1,
                                   end= human_protein_coding_KZFPs$end),
                   gene_name = human_protein_coding_KZFPs$Label)


mcols(MER61E_regions)$Response <- ifelse(
  MER61E_regions$name %in% MER61E_set_3,"Acute","Non-acute")
seqlevelsStyle(KZFP_gr) <- "UCSC"

```

```{r DIST list}

nearest_hits <- distanceToNearest(MER61E_regions,KZFP_gr, ignore.strand=TRUE)

distance_df <- data.frame(
  Peak_name = MER61E_regions$name[queryHits(nearest_hits)],
  Response = MER61E_regions$Response[queryHits(nearest_hits)],
  KZFP_gene = KZFP_gr$gene_name[subjectHits(nearest_hits)],
  Distance_bp = mcols(nearest_hits)$distance
) %>%
  mutate(
    Distance_kb = Distance_bp / 1000,
    Response = factor(Response, levels = c("Acute", "Non-acute"))
  )

ggplot(distance_df,
       aes(x = Response, y = Distance_kb, fill = Response)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = "log1p",
    labels = scales::label_comma()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distance of MER61E elements to nearest KZFP gene",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Distance to nearest KZFP gene (kb)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

wilcox.test(
  Distance_bp ~ Response,
  data = distance_df,
  exact = FALSE
)

distance_df %>%
  group_by(Response) %>%
  summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    median_kb = median(Distance_kb),
    mean_kb = mean(Distance_kb),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary(distance_df$Distance_kb)

distance_df %>%
  arrange(Distance_bp) %>%
  dplyr::select(Peak_name, KZFP_gene, Distance_kb) %>%
  head()
```
```{r}
excluded <- MER61E_regions[-unique(queryHits(nearest_hits))]

data.frame(
  MER61E = excluded$name,
  Response = excluded$Response,
  Chromosome = as.character(seqnames(excluded))
)

table(
  Chromosome = as.character(seqnames(excluded)),
  Response = excluded$Response
)

setdiff(
  unique(as.character(seqnames(MER61E_regions))),
  unique(as.character(seqnames(KZFP_gr)))
)

distance_df %>%
  group_by(Response) %>%
  summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    within_100kb = sum(Distance_kb <= 100),
    within_500kb = sum(Distance_kb <= 500),
    within_1Mb = sum(Distance_kb <= 1000),
    within_5Mb = sum(Distance_kb <= 5000),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

distance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Within_1Mb = Distance_kb <= 1000
  ) %>%
  count(Response, Within_1Mb) %>%
  group_by(Response) %>%
  mutate(Percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

fisher.test(
  table(
    distance_df$Response,
    distance_df$Distance_kb <= 1000
  )
)
```
